title: tessera.log-event/1
description: One line of `--log-format json` on stderr (05 §2): an event of public data only (05 §3 OBS-1). A line carries no schema identifier; this schema versions the format.

ts.description: When the event happened: UTC, RFC 3339, to the microsecond (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ).

level.description: error, a failed operation; warn, a degraded but valid state; info, phase boundaries and results; debug, per-stage detail; trace, per-tile detail, absent from release builds.

target.description: The Rust module that emitted the event.

span_path.description: The spans the event lies in, from the outermost.

fields.description: The event's typed fields; `message` is its template with every named field substituted.
Public values only: integers, booleans, and the text of fixed identifiers or of values cleared as Public.
